svg.title: Lord of the Hosts of the Mighty: The Blasted Tower (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Above, Mars, the Key's attribution; below, the letter Peh (פ); Key XVI, Path 27. Its ring: number 73 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791650486056-2p72bhf224f.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
